newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends quiet session lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends quiet session lower.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended a quiet session lower on Monday with weakness tied to a drop in corn and soybeans and to liquidation of the July ahead of expiry, traders said.
"It was a pretty slow session," a trader said. "Weakness was tied to weakness in other grains. People were rolling out of the July, both ways."
Traders said Louis Dreyfus was a late seller.
Rice ended seven to four cents per cwt lower with September down 4-1/2 at $9.46.
CBOT estimated volume at 350 lots, down from Friday's 437.
